build_fixed_high_level_policy: build a FixedHighLevelPolicy instance that executes a fixed sequence of high-level actions from a PDDL solution
parse_solution_actions: parse the PDDL problem solution into a list of action names and argument tuples for execution
get_next_skill: get the next skill index and arguments from the fixed solution plan for a batch of environments
apply_mask_to_skill_index: apply a binary mask tensor to reset the next skill index for filtered environments
filter_envs: filter and clean up stateful variables to match only the active environments in the policy
